title: Need basic instructions and better packaging. But so-so,
text: Need basic instructions and better packaging. But so-so,. What would have been nice it simple instructions on the size of the drill bit for screws into wood and for the anchors into drywall. You will need a long handle screwdriver to put the screws into the wall in a straight fashion, as it must reach through the othe side of the basket. Mine came bent as it wasn’t packaged with much protection. But it serves its purpose. Let’s see if it is durable. If not I’ll update you.
